wording: ### Income and timing
disposition: Exact original unit or bounded R109–111 qualification; historical wording retained in preimage

wording: - **Income**: rent; Umlagen (running costs paid by the tenant); settlement back-payments; a deposit kept and set off against rent, running costs or damage; payments for antenna, wind or Wi-Fi sites; a furniture surcharge; VAT received on an opted let; grants for rent (2025 instructions, lines 13 to 31). wording: - **Umlagen count twice**: income when received; the running costs paid are Werbungskosten.
disposition: Exact original unit or bounded R109–111 qualification; historical wording retained in preimage

wording: - **Cash basis** ([§ 11 EStG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__11.html)): income when received, costs when paid. Regularly recurring items paid shortly before or after the turn of the year belong to the year they relate to. Rent received in advance for a let of more than five years **may** be spread over the period; costs paid in advance for more than five years **must** be spread. A market-level loan discount (Disagio) is deductible when paid.

wording: ### Werbungskosten ([§ 9 EStG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__9.html))
disposition: Exact original unit or bounded R109–111 qualification; historical wording retained in preimage

wording: Costs "zur Erwerbung, Sicherung und Erhaltung der Einnahmen", deductible in the year paid, only for a property that earns or is intended to earn rent. Costs attributable to the owner’s private use or free-use parts are not rental expenses. Letting individual rooms within the owner’s home can generate deductible rental costs; allocate those costs to the actual let part.
disposition: Exact original unit or bounded R109–111 qualification; historical wording retained in preimage

wording: - **Deductible**: loan interest so far as linked to the property, and the cost of raising the loan (§ 9(1) no. 1); property tax, other public charges and building insurance (no. 2); AfA and § 7b (no. 7); liability insurance; running costs, including those passed on; Hausgeld **except** the maintenance-reserve part, which is deductible only when the owners' association spends it; management; the tax adviser's rental share; tenancy legal fees; advertising and the broker for finding a tenant; rent-account fees; maintenance.
disposition: Exact original unit or bounded R109–111 qualification; historical wording retained in preimage

wording: - **Travel**: actual cost, or 30 cents per km **driven** by car (§ 9(1) no. 4a and § 9(3) EStG with [§ 5(2) BRKG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/brkg_2005/__5.html)). If the property were a first place of activity, the commuting allowance of EUR 0.38 per full km one way applies instead. When a let property is one is not settled on the pages read: ask the accountant.
disposition: Exact original unit or bounded R109–111 qualification; historical wording retained in preimage

wording:
- **Not deductible**: loan principal (Tilgung); transfer tax, notary and broker on the purchase (they go into acquisition cost); reserve payments until spent; costs attributable to own-use or free-use parts; the unpaid part of a cheap let; fines (§ 9(5) with § 4(5) no. 8 EStG); income tax, solidarity surcharge and church tax.

For mixed private and rental use, first attribute identifiable costs directly. Allocate shared costs by a justified, documented measure, such as the actual usable-floor-area ratio, and explain a first allocation (published 2025 ELSTER instructions, applied here to the unchanged rental-expense principle, not claimed 2026 form lines). For example, an identifiable rented-room repair of EUR 1,000 plus a shared roof repair of EUR 10,000 at an independently supported 20% rental share gives EUR 3,000 rental costs before any other applicable limitation; private-only costs stay excluded. The 20% is a stipulated allocation fact, not a universal prescribed ratio.
disposition: Exact original unit or bounded R109–111 qualification; historical wording retained in preimage

wording: - **§ 35c energy credit**: only for a building used **only** for the owner's own housing ([§ 35c(2) EStG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__35c.html)), and not for costs deducted as Werbungskosten (§ 35c(3)). For a let property, energy works are maintenance or production cost under the rules below, never the § 35c credit.
disposition: Exact original unit or bounded R109–111 qualification; historical wording retained in preimage

wording: ### Building depreciation (AfA, [§ 7 EStG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__7.html))
disposition: Exact original unit or bounded R109–111 qualification; historical wording retained in preimage

wording: - **Completion date decides the straight-line rate**, not the purchase date: 3% after 2022, 2% for 1925 to 2022, 2.5% before 1925 (§ 7(4) sentence 1 no. 2). This covers every privately held building, housing or not, including flats and separate parts of a building (§ 7(5b)). The separate 3% rate in no. 1 is for business-asset buildings not used for housing: never use it for a private shop or office completed before 2023.
disposition: Exact original unit or bounded R109–111 qualification; historical wording retained in preimage

wording: - **Shorter actual life.** If the actual life is under 33 years (after 2022), 50 years (1925 to 2022) or 40 years (before 1925), that life may be used (§ 7(4) sentence 2). The 2025 instructions call this an exceptional case that must be proved to the tax office. Refer.
disposition: Exact original unit or bounded R109–111 qualification; historical wording retained in preimage

wording: - **Older staged rates.** A building built or bought in its completion year under an application or contract before 1 January 2006 (housing; earlier dates for the other historic branches) may be on the staged rates of § 7(5). Ask what past returns used; refer any change.
disposition: Exact original unit or bounded R109–111 qualification; historical wording retained in preimage

wording: - **Acquired free of charge** (gift or inheritance): continue the previous owner's rate (2025 instructions).
disposition: Exact original unit or bounded R109–111 qualification; historical wording retained in preimage

wording: - **Declining-balance AfA, § 7(5a).** Instead of 3% straight-line, 5% of the remaining value ("Restwert") each year, so far as the building is used for **housing**, if all hold: it is in Germany, the EU or the EEA; the client built it, or bought it by the end of the completion year; and construction started (the date on the construction-start notice required by state law; where none is required, the client declares a voluntary notice) or the binding purchase contract was made after 30 September 2023 and before 1 October 2029. No extraordinary write-down while it runs. Switching to straight-line is allowed, then on the remaining value and remaining life.
disposition: Exact original unit or bounded R109–111 qualification; historical wording retained in preimage

wording: - **Base.** Price plus side costs (transfer tax, notary, land register, the buyer's broker) under [§ 255 HGB](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/hgb/__255.html), less the land share. Land is never depreciated. A maintenance reserve bought with a flat is excluded (2025 instructions). Grants reduce the base (line 89). A former own home let for the first time needs a first computation.
disposition: Exact original unit or bounded R109–111 qualification; historical wording retained in preimage

wording: - **Price split.** Split by the ratio of market values, not by the residual-value method (2025 instructions). The [BMF purchase-price split tool](https://www.bundesfinanzministerium.de/Content/DE/Downloads/Steuern/Berechnung-Aufteilung-Grundstueckskaufpreis.html) makes or tests a split. A contract split at arm's length or an expert valuation may also be used; the tax office may challenge a high building share.
disposition: Exact original unit or bounded R109–111 qualification; historical wording retained in preimage

wording: - **First-year month cut.** Cut one twelfth for each full month before the month of acquisition or completion (§ 7(1) sentence 4). Statute applies it to § 7(5a) (sentence 5). For straight-line AfA, the BMF letter of 21 May 2025 on § 7b says so too: "bei Fertigstellung nach dem 31. Januar wäre eine zeitanteilige Kürzung der linearen AfA im Jahr der Fertigstellung erforderlich" (example 7). Only the old staged § 7(5) rates take a full first year.
disposition: Exact original unit or bounded R109–111 qualification; historical wording retained in preimage

wording: - **For example**: completed February 2026, bought with benefit and burden from 1 April 2026, building share EUR 300,000. From April, rent is EUR 1,200 plus Umlagen of EUR 250 a month: income is 9 × (1,200 + 250) = EUR 13,050. Interest of EUR 9,000, running costs of EUR 2,250 and management of EUR 600 total EUR 11,850. The declining-balance loss is 13,050 − 11,850 − 11,250 = EUR 10,050; with straight-line AfA the loss is EUR 5,550.

wording: - **End**: until fully written off, or the year of sale.
disposition: Exact original unit or bounded R109–111 qualification; historical wording retained in preimage

Own use possible at any time: split vacancy by the ratio of own use to letting. Own use limited to set times (for example let through an agent): only the reserved time is own use, and vacancy counts as letting. Never used by the owner and let only to changing guests: give the letting days usual in that place, from tourist office or municipal records.

wording: - **Proving there is no own use** (para. 17): the client shows one of: letting handed to an unrelated agent with own use excluded by contract for the whole year; the flat is in or right next to the client's own home, which meets the client's needs; the client has more than one holiday flat in the place and uses only one; or letting days at least equal the local seasonal average. Otherwise the client must prove it, and with too few letting days show stronger advertising (para. 18). Short stays for servicing, key handover, cleaning, checks, repairs or owners' meetings are not own use; longer stays or stays with family need explaining (para. 19).

Only costs for let days and vacancy allocated to letting go in (para. 39); mixed costs (interest, property charges, maintenance, AfA, insurance) are split by days of each use (para. 40). Vacancy: if own use is limited to set times, only those count as own use; if possible at any time, split vacancy by the ratio of own use to letting; if the extent of own use cannot be established, vacancy is split 50/50 (paras. 22, 23). The forecast then follows para. 34: 30 years, § 7(4) AfA, five-year average, 10% margins (see the cheap-let forecast above).
